## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes (if applicable).

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] New indicator implementation
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Performance improvement / optimization
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (`ruff check .` and `ruff format .`).
- [ ] All indicators return Polars expressions (`pl.Expr`).
- [ ] I have added tests in `tests/` that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes (`pytest`).
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / README where appropriate.
